title: Don Ray Clarke
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to the Argentina South Mission, 1965-67
Married Mary Anne Jackson, June 5, 1970, Idaho Falls Temple; six children
Bachelor's in Business Administration from BYU, 1970; MBA from Washington State University
Senior executive positions and CEO in several major companies; teacher and administrator; basketball coach; volunteer at Southern Virginia University.
Elders' Quorum President; Stake Young Men's President; Bishop; High Councilor; Assistant Director of Church Hosting; Stake President
President of the Bolivia Santa Cruz Mission, 2001-04
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
